composition: Anchor main characters in the center or left-center, occupying 50% to 60% of the frame width.
Reserve 30% to 40% of the frame (typically right or top-right) for large-scale 3D titles.
Layer UI elements, brand assets, and secondary logos exclusively along the bottom 20% margin.
Use a split-screen or triptych grid layout when presenting brand guidelines, dividing assets 50/50 or 60/40.
typographie: Place primary titles behind the main character's shoulders or overlapping the lower-middle third to establish depth.
Combine a bold, chiseled 3D sans-serif or gothic block font with a thin, vibrant script-style overlay.
Set secondary text (names, URLs) in clean, wide, all-caps sans-serif or gothic blackletter, scaled to under 15% of frame height.
lumiere: Apply high-contrast, directional rim lighting (white or primary brand color) to outline character silhouettes.
Use strong under-glow or ambient backlighting from cars, neon signs, or light beams to separate subjects from dark backgrounds.
Keep facial fill light soft and ambient, maintaining high-contrast shadows.
etalonnage: Maintain a desaturated, high-contrast base with deep grays, blacks, and desaturated skin tones.
Inject a single, highly saturated brand accent color: Mint Green (#20E39B/#59EAA0), Gold (#D4AF37), Orange (#FF8C00), or Purple (#8A2BE2).
effets: Layer soft ground-level smoke, fog, or dust particles around the characters' waists and car wheels.
Apply subtle halftone dot patterns, light film grain, and localized horizontal lens flares.
Incorporate floating 3D metallic elements or light leaks matching the brand accent color.
logo: Position a circular monogram or stylized vector emblem in the bottom UI bar or as a repeating badge on the right asset panel.
interdits: Do not place floating props (like cigars or weapons) without realistic hand contact and shadow integration.
Avoid hard, unblended transitions between indoor foregrounds and outdoor background murals.
Do not apply uniform rain or scratch textures across the entire frame; mask them to preserve depth-of-field.
Avoid illegible blackletter fonts over busy, high-contrast backgrounds.
